name: macOS Native Screen Capture CLI Trigger (`screencapture`)
summary: Captures full desktop screenshots directly to a specified file path using native macOS terminal commands for downstream vision analysis.
steps: Execute native macOS command `screencapture screen-guide/latest.png` from python or shell script.
Save high-resolution image to local execution directory.
Pass local screenshot image file path to agent or vision model for screen state analysis.
jarvis_use: Provide fast, lightweight desktop screen grabbing without reliance on heavy third-party screen recording utilities.

name: Python Pillow Visual Pointer & Label Overlay Generator (`screen-guide`)
summary: Calculates pixel coordinates from target percentage locations and draws a high-contrast directional arrow with a labeled text pill overlay onto a desktop screenshot.
steps: Capture desktop image to `screen-guide/latest.png`.
Pass target x and y percentage coordinates along with label text to Python helper script.
Calculate absolute image pixel position based on image dimensions.
Use Pillow (PIL) to draw a red-orange arrow with a white border landing on the target coordinate.
Render a dark background pill containing white text near the arrow tail.
Open generated image file in macOS Preview to show target UI element to user.
jarvis_use: Visually guide human operators to specific UI elements on screen without needing to manipulate target app DOM or code.

name: Claude Code Autonomous Driving Rules Guardrail (`CLAUDE.md`)
summary: Defines explicit execution constraints in CLAUDE.md to prevent unauthorized computer control actions and maintain human control.
steps: Add trigger phrase condition (e.g., requires 'take over and...' phrase to initiate computer control).
Enforce plan output requirement: capture screenshot and list 3-4 planned steps prior to executing inputs.
Implement single-step loop cycle: screenshot -> analyze -> act -> speak status line.
Configure immediate halt rule when operator types or speaks 'stop'.
Set strict refusal rules for sensitive actions such as financial transactions, payments, password entry, file deletions, or messaging without confirmation.
jarvis_use: Constrain autonomous computer interaction routines with hard safety boundaries.

name: Draft-Only Safety Policy for Ad & Payment Platforms
summary: Enforces automatic stopping at draft status during browser automation workflows to prevent accidental financial expenditure or public post publishing.
steps: Navigate target platform (e.g. Meta Ads Manager) and automate field population.
Save campaign or configuration to draft state.
Detect live execution controls (e.g., 'Publish' or 'Submit Order' buttons).
Halt execution immediately before triggering live actions.
Prompt human operator for explicit manual verification and publishing.
jarvis_use: Protect user accounts and payment methods during full browser control task automation.

name: Native macOS Text-to-Speech Feedback (`say` CLI)
summary: Triggers local, real-time voice updates during automated steps using the native macOS `say` command line utility.
steps: Append system call commands `say "<short status text>"` to automation script execution steps.
Execute speech synthesis concurrently with UI actions.
Provide quiet mode command override to disable audio updates when requested.
jarvis_use: Provide zero-latency audio narration of background agent steps without third-party speech API costs.

name: Zip Archive Claude Code Skill Package Installation
summary: Installs multi-script agent packages from local zip archives using a single natural language command in Claude Code.
steps: Download skill zip archive (e.g., `brain-jarvis-skill-v6-MAC.zip`) into local `~/Downloads` folder.
Launch Claude Code CLI in terminal.
Issue natural language instruction: `Install the Jarvis skill from my Downloads (v6 zip)`.
Allow agent to unpack zip archive, extract configuration files, build dependencies, and launch local services.
jarvis_use: Package complex multi-tool Jarvis setups into 1-prompt automated installers.

name: Local 3D Force-Directed Knowledge Graph & Agent Status Dashboard
summary: Serves an interactive 3D node graph web UI on `localhost:4719` reflecting stored second brain knowledge, connected skills, and live status states.
steps: Run local web server on port `4719`.
Render 3D force-directed graph displaying nodes for skills, tools, notes, and local business data.
Mount dynamic status indicators (`J.A.R.V.I.S. ONLINE / DRIVING / SPEAKING / LISTENING`).
Stream live assistant audio transcripts into lower subtitle overlay panel.
jarvis_use: Provide constant visual observability into Jarvis memory graph and agent operational state.

name: Telegram Voice Note to Google Sheet & Invoice PDF Generation Workflow
summary: Parses incoming voice messages, matches lead details in a spreadsheet database, and generates formatted invoice PDFs and editable Google Docs.
steps: Receive voice message via Telegram messaging integration.
Extract client name, requested service, and project parameters from audio.
Cross-reference lead details in Google Sheets (`Leads` tab).
Generate populated PDF invoice in Google Drive.
Create matching editable Google Doc invoice and return links to operator for review.
jarvis_use: Automate billing and client database updates directly from informal voice notes.

name: Local Dashboard Tool Armory Card Management Hub
summary: Provides a centralized visual integration hub on `localhost:4719` for toggling and inspecting third-party service connections.
steps: Display grid of third-party integration cards (Gmail, Drive, Sheets, Stripe, GitHub, Zapier, etc.).
Manage API keys, tokens, and OAuth status per service card.
Expose connected tool capability sets to local Claude Code agent during execution.
jarvis_use: Manage external API integrations and execution tools from a visual local control panel.

name: macOS Computer Control Entitlements Provisioning
summary: Configures OS Privacy & Security settings to enable accessibility and screen capture rights required for CLI computer control tools.
steps: Open macOS `System Settings -> Privacy & Security`.
Navigate to `Screen Recording` and grant access permission to Terminal / iTerm / Claude Code.
Navigate to `Accessibility` and enable permission toggles for Terminal / automation utilities.
Restart terminal session to apply permissions.
jarvis_use: Ensure proper OS permissions are configured prior to running desktop automation tools.
